purpose: A short hint bubble that names or explains its trigger on hover or keyboard focus. It never carries the only copy of information and never holds an action.

notFor.case: Rich content, links or buttons in a floating panel.
Help or rules a form field needs to show all the time.
A message that must be read, such as an error or a warning.

Open.meaning: The trigger is hovered (after the provider's delay) or has keyboard focus.
Open.visual: Bubble and arrow in the Variant's fill: Action/primary/default with Content/on-action text (default), Surface/muted with Content/primary (secondary), Surface/inverse with Content/inverse (inverse), Status/critical/surface-solid with Status/critical/on-solid (critical), Status/info/surface-solid with Status/info/on-solid (info); the popover-md lift. Enters on popover-enter.

Closed.meaning: The pointer left, focus moved or Escape was pressed.

a11y.keyboard: Never focusable itself. It opens on keyboard focus of the trigger and Escape hides it (Radix Tooltip).
a11y.reducedMotion: Fades in and out instead of popping (the popover-enter / popover-exit reduced-motion bodies in lib/motion.ts).
notes: The trigger is described by it through aria-describedby.

openQuestions: Touch screens have no hover: should a tap open the tooltip, or must touch users get the text another way?
The open delay comes from TooltipProvider; what is Escala's default delay?
